articles.title: Beadlock Bolt Circle
articles.summary: Dense beadlock bolt heads and washer rings in indexed circles; high-contrast machined metal glint. Reads as a clean smooth sheen with a light glitter dusting; the bolt rings are only visible on a wheel-sized area.
articles.what: Dense beadlock bolt heads, washer rings, and indexed circular rows. Up close: Sparse tiny bright specks and a few small ring-shaped ovals in loose rows, about 100 px apart, over otherwise smooth sheen. On metal the highlight band is dusted with pin-point glints; on satin only a few dots show. From a distance: Reads as a clean smooth sheen with a light glitter dusting; the bolt rings are only visible on a wheel-sized area. It changes the shine only, never the colour. Channels it touches: metal, roughness, clearcoat. Group: Definitive Spec Replacements (Legacy collection tab of the spec overlay picker). Texture detail: micro.
how: Click a zone card and expand SPEC OVERLAYS.
Click + ADD SPEC OVERLAY, open the Legacy collection tab and the group "Definitive Spec Replacements", or search for "Beadlock Bolt Circle".
Click it, then click Add this overlay in the Inspect surface window.
Set Strength (default 50%) and tick the Metallic, Roughness and Clearcoat boxes you want.
Use Size and Rotation to make the texture finer, then render.
tips: Wheels and wheel-face parts where the bolt circle forms
Hood or roof on metal for a light speck dusting
No effect on numbers.
A few faint dots and tiny rings; very quiet
Pairs well with: metallic, chrome, gloss.
pitfalls: Not rivet or bolt decals: it shows up as faint specks, no visible bolts at car-panel scale
Not metal flake: the dots sit in a rough indexed row layout
Avoid: organic or retro themes, large smooth panels where bolts look random.
articles.intent_note: A spec pattern changes the shine only: metal, roughness and clearcoat, never the paint colour.
articles.paint_advice: It cannot recolour anything. Metal added to a light paint looks bright; metal added to a dark paint stays dark, because metal reflection inherits the paint colour. Pair it with a paint that gives the gloss difference something to show on.

combos.why: Up to five overlays stack in order; a strong overlay can wash out the ones below it.
The blend mode decides how this overlay meets the base shine. Normal is the safe start.
Coat values 1 to 15 and roughness under 15 on non-chrome pixels are raised to safe values on export.

examples.goal: Layer Beadlock Bolt Circle over a base finish.
examples.result: The shine of the zone gets this texture while the colours stay put.

articles.title: Louvered Aluminum Slot
articles.summary: Stamped aluminium louvers: dark recessed slots between bright leading lips, fine horizontal banding with a slight directional sheen. Reads as a fine horizontal-lined, vented-metal texture; at distance it becomes a faint striped sheen inside the highlight.
articles.what: Stamped aluminum louvers with dark slots and bright leading lips. Up close: A tight grid of short horizontal dashes, like brick-bond slots or vent louvers, in staggered rows about 8-10 px tall. Each slot catches a bright lip in the highlight; between them the surface stays dark. The rows run straight and level. From a distance: Reads as a fine horizontal-lined, vented-metal texture; at distance it becomes a faint striped sheen inside the highlight. It changes the shine only, never the colour. Up close: Parallel rows of tiny linked dashes about 14 px apart, running slightly uphill across the panel like stacked-dime TIG weld beads, each dash a short bright oval with a dark gap.
